inputs.question: Total revenue from the 'Beverages' category during the 'Summer Beverages 2017' dates as defined in the marketing calendar. Return a float rounded to 2 decimals.

outputs.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice*od.Quantity*(1-od.Discount)),2) FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-06-01' AND '2017-06-30' AND c.CategoryName='Beverages'
